decisions.reason: Despite higher commercialization risk than the plant products, it is a flagship innovation aligned with the firm's R&D-led circular-economy strategy, so management would likely continue backing it for another year.
This decontamination plant is close to the core modular machinery business, was prominently marketed, and fits the firm's decentralized treatment offering, making withdrawal unlikely.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant strongly matches the firm's established product logic and customer needs for site-specific decentralized recycling, so it is very likely to stay on the market.
